title: Guta Rakarasika reHukuru Husingaenzaniswi
intro: Rudzi rukuru rwaimbotonga nzvimbo dzakakura dzepasi, ruchirumbidzwa nekuda kwezvivakwa zvirefu zvaisvika kumatenga. Asi pasi pehukuru uhwu, kuramba kwakasimba kwakakura - kuramba kuteerera yambiro yaMwari yakatumirwa kubva munharaunda pachayo. Kuzvikudza nekuzvikudza kwaizokurumidza kuunza chirango chakafanana neicho chisina kumboonekwa nenyika kana matenga.
clues: Taimbotonga nyika yakakura, tichizvikudza nesimba rataifunga kuti hapana imwe nyika yaigona kuenzana naro.
Umambo hwedu hwaizivikanwa nezvivakwa zvirefu zvine mbiru dzakakura dzaive dzisina anokwikwidza nadzo munyika dzese dzaizivikanwa.
Nyevero yakabva munharaunda yedu yakasimuka, ichikurudzira mumwe nemumwe wedu kuti azviise pasi peMusiki Mumwe chete.
Takaramba shoko ratakapihwa uye takaramba kusiya nzira yatakagara nhaka.
Mhepo ine hasha, ine simba guru yakamutswa kuti irwise, ikatisiya tisina dziviriro zvachose.
Takasiyiwa semiti yemichindwe ine makomba, takapararira uye takakanganikwa, sechidzidzo kuchizvarwa chimwe nechimwe chinotevera.
